card.name: The word agent after single
card.fires_on: The word "agent" (or "Agent") right after "single" in drug-label text about a drug used alone. It also fires on "agent" after a drug class or disease name.

modes.label: Single agent
modes.description: "agent" follows "single" when a drug is used alone rather than in combination.
modes.example: as a single<< agent>> or in combination with pembrolizum

modes.label: Class or disease agent
modes.description: "agent" follows a drug class or disease name, as in antihypertensive agent or vCJD agent.
